Grant complimentary or invoiced Managed subscriptions to this vendor's billing account. Each subscription puts one product on Managed once it is assigned.

A grant starts nothing on its own. It waits until an owner seat accepts the Managed plan agreement on the vendor's Billing tab, and owner seats get an email asking them to. If the vendor signed a deal that accepts the agreement, record it below and the grant is active at once. Then the subscriptions wait unassigned on the billing account, and the vendor chooses which products they go on.
